author: steven5703
body:
Recently I've seen some donors switching teams because of a monument defence or something. It's really cheap and I'm sure the non donators agree also. (i admit i have done this a few times before)

Example:
I join red. Blue team has an op defence consisting the whole apex crew at the monument.
I give it a try and go for the monument a few times until I give up. So I switch teams to win easier.

Technically this is pay to win. (not saying teamstacking isn't)
  
Possible solution:
Donators can ONLY use "/join (team)" BEFORE the game starts. After they can only use /join like a non donator. This might not help teamstacking but it will help changing teams because of how good the other team is.(maybe)
Possible solution 2 (Samir_14):
You can only use "/join (team" once every game.

replies.body: the thing is, the donor team picking is not even really something limited to donors. if you're not a donor, keep pressing /join before the game starts and the team eventually switches. if you're already playing, /leave and then /join gives a pretty good chance of team switching. and that's not really a bad thing. the teams are still even, but if you're a donor, you can make it uneven by picking anyways. but i don't see that it's a big deal personally, there're better things that should be fixed.
